name: pain
description: The feeling of a physical or mental injury.

variations.name: physical pain
variations.description: The body can be injured in many different ways, and pain is the way it tells us to seek relief.

variations.name: mental pain
variations.description: The mind can also be injured in many ways. It expresses a need for help with sensations ranging from minor anxiety to depression.

conditions: discomfort relating to mental processing may be triggered by a traumatic event or by physical injury
